limits: These fixed-seed observations do not estimate a population damage rate or establish an exponential timing law.
PROB=0 prevents the modeled attrition consequence, so no positive damage consequence, item damage, repair or attrition behavior is proved.
Intermediate DAMP, other DAMRT settings, continuous missions, multiple aircraft, GUI visual behavior and cross-engine parity remain untested.
scope: One fixed seed, one high DAMRT source value, three two-hour fixed missions, and a zero-probability attrition consequence. The native log shows 5, 2 and 3 BATTLE-HIT occurrences strictly during the three successful sorties; SystemResults.NDAM counts them in matching half-hour bins.
